```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# This script needs to read data files that live OUTSIDE this git repository 
# For access to those files, see README 

data_root <- dirname(here::here())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = data_root)
setwd(data_root)  

source(file.path(here::here(), "02_primary_analyses", "00_setup.R"))
all_cmap_results <- read_checkpoint("all_cmap_results")
mimicker_summary <- read_checkpoint("mimicker_summary")
opposer_summary <- read_checkpoint("opposer_summary")
```


## MOAs Barplot 
```{r}
mimicker_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(all_cmap_results, function(res, analysis_name) {
  res$mimickers_compound_stability %>%
    mutate(analysis = analysis_name, direction = "Mimicker") %>%
    dplyr::select(analysis, direction, pert_iname, MOA, Targets, n_quality_sigs, n_cell_lines,
                  median_NCS, median_TAS, median_fdr_q_nlog10)})

opposer_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(all_cmap_results, function(res, analysis_name) {
  res$opposers_compound_stability %>%
    mutate(analysis = analysis_name, direction = "Opposer") %>%
    dplyr::select(analysis, direction, pert_iname, MOA, Targets, n_quality_sigs, n_cell_lines,
                  median_NCS, median_TAS, median_fdr_q_nlog10)})

compound_long <- bind_rows(mimicker_long, opposer_long) %>%
  mutate(MOA = na_if(MOA, ""),
         MOA = replace_na(MOA, "Unknown"))

recurrent_compounds <- compound_long %>%
  distinct(direction, pert_iname, analysis, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(direction, pert_iname) %>%
  mutate(n_analyses_present = n_distinct(analysis)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_analyses_present == 3)

recurrent_moa_long <- recurrent_compounds %>%
  separate_rows(MOA, sep = "\\||,") %>%
  mutate(MOA = str_trim(MOA),
         MOA = if_else(MOA == "" | is.na(MOA), "Unknown", MOA)) %>%
  distinct(direction, pert_iname, MOA, .keep_all = TRUE)

moa_bar_df <- recurrent_moa_long %>%
  group_by(direction, MOA) %>%
  summarise(n_compounds = n_distinct(pert_iname),
            compounds = paste(sort(unique(pert_iname)), collapse = ", "),
            median_NCS = median(median_NCS, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_TAS = median(median_TAS, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(direction, desc(n_compounds), desc(abs(median_NCS)))

moa_bar_df_mimicker <- moa_bar_df %>%
  filter(direction == "Mimicker", MOA != "Unknown", n_compounds > 2) 

moa_bar_df_opposer <- moa_bar_df %>%
  filter(direction == "Opposer", MOA != "Unknown",  n_compounds > 2)

moa_bar_df_mimicker <- moa_bar_df_mimicker %>%
  arrange(desc(n_compounds)) %>%
  mutate(MOA = factor(MOA, levels = rev(unique(MOA))))

mimicker_MOA_plot <- ggplot(moa_bar_df_mimicker, aes(x = n_compounds, y = MOA)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, fill = "#2698B1") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,2,4,6,8,10)) +
  labs(x = "# of Compounds", y = NULL, title = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.75), 
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 1, b = 5, l = 1, unit = "pt"))

moa_bar_df_opposer <- moa_bar_df_opposer %>%
  arrange(desc(n_compounds)) %>%
  mutate(MOA = factor(MOA, levels = rev(unique(MOA))))

opposer_MOA_plot <- ggplot(moa_bar_df_opposer, aes(x = n_compounds, y = MOA)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, fill = "#8D1946") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,2,4,6,8,10)) +
  labs(x = "# of Compounds", y = NULL, title = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.75), 
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 1, b = 5, l = 1, unit = "pt"))


write.csv(moa_bar_df %>% filter(MOA != "Unknown"), "CMap Analysis/CMap Processed Results/Summaries/Mechanism_of_Action_Counts.csv")

```

## Compound Boxplot 

### Load signature results 
```{r}
## Read CLUE signature-level ranked results across all gene-set sizes
top50_sigs <- read_csv("CMap Analysis/CMap Processed Results/ED-M6 Results/EDM6_Top50/EDM6_Top50_Signature_Level_Ranked.csv")
top75_sigs <- read_csv("CMap Analysis/CMap Processed Results/ED-M6 Results/EDM6_Top75/EDM6_Top75_Signature_Level_Ranked.csv")
top100_sigs <- read_csv("CMap Analysis/CMap Processed Results/ED-M6 Results/EDM6_Top100//EDM6_Top100_Signature_Level_Ranked.csv")

all_sigs <- bind_rows(Top50 = top50_sigs,
                      Top75 = top75_sigs, Top100 = top100_sigs,
                      .id = "analysis")


all_sigs_collapsed <- all_sigs %>%
  mutate(Signature_Class = case_when(ncs > 0 ~ "Mimicker", ncs < 0 ~ "Opposer", TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Signature_Class)) %>%
  group_by(Signature_Class, pert_iname, sig_id) %>%
  summarise(median_ncs = median(ncs, na.rm = TRUE), n_analyses_present = n_distinct(analysis), .groups = "drop")

```

### Plot
```{r}
## Top Compounds 
ranked_mimickers <- mimicker_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(MOA) & MOA != "" & !grepl("^BRD-", pert_iname)) %>%
  filter(n_analyses_present == 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_of_median_NCS), desc(median_of_median_fdr_q_nlog10), desc(median_n_quality_sigs))
length(ranked_mimickers$pert_iname) # 90

ranked_opposers <- opposer_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(MOA) & MOA != "" & !grepl("^BRD-", pert_iname)) %>%
  filter(n_analyses_present == 3) %>%
  arrange(median_of_median_NCS, median_of_median_fdr_q_nlog10, median_n_quality_sigs)
length(ranked_opposers$pert_iname) # 77

overlap_compounds <- intersect(ranked_mimickers$pert_iname, ranked_opposers$pert_iname)
# tretinoin, dexamethasone, I-BET-762, manumycin-a, tozasertib, lapatinib, sirolimus, ibrutinib, tanespimycin, GDC-0068, everolimus

length(overlap_compounds) # 11

# get ordering based on signature-level medians
mimicker_order <- all_sigs_collapsed %>%
  filter(Signature_Class == "Mimicker", pert_iname %in% ranked_mimickers$pert_iname) %>%
  group_by(pert_iname) %>%
  summarise(med_sig_ncs = median(median_ncs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(med_sig_ncs)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 40) %>%
  pull(pert_iname)

# apply ordering
mimickers_plot_df <- all_sigs_collapsed %>%
  filter(Signature_Class == "Mimicker", pert_iname %in% mimicker_order) %>%
  mutate(pert_iname = factor(pert_iname, levels = rev(mimicker_order)))

top_mimickers_plot <- ggplot(mimickers_plot_df, aes(x = pert_iname, y = median_ncs)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#2698B1", color = "black", outlier.color = "grey50",   width = 0.6,
  linewidth = 0.4,
  median.linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Compound", y = "Median NCS") +
  theme_bw() + 
      theme(
      plot.title =element_text(size = 7, color = "black", face = "bold", hjust = 1),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.75, fill = NA), 
      legend.position = "none", 
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 1, b = 5, l = 1, unit = "pt"))

opposer_order <- all_sigs_collapsed %>%
  filter(Signature_Class == "Opposer", pert_iname %in% ranked_opposers$pert_iname) %>%
  group_by(pert_iname) %>%
  summarise(med_sig_ncs = median(median_ncs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(med_sig_ncs) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 40) %>%
  pull(pert_iname)

opposers_plot_df <- all_sigs_collapsed %>%
  filter(Signature_Class == "Opposer", pert_iname %in% opposer_order) %>%
  mutate(pert_iname = factor(pert_iname, levels = rev(opposer_order)))

top_opposers_plot <- ggplot(opposers_plot_df, aes(x = pert_iname, y = median_ncs)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#8D1946", color = "black", outlier.color = "grey50",   width = 0.6,
  linewidth = 0.4,
  median.linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Compound", y = "Median NCS") +
  theme_bw() + 
      theme(
      plot.title =element_text(size = 7, color = "black", face = "bold", , hjust = 1),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.75, fill = NA), 
      legend.position = "none", 
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 1, b = 5, l = 1, unit = "pt"))

intersect(opposer_order, mimicker_order)
# tretinoin, and manumycin-a are compounds that are in the top 40 for both mimickers (#37, #40) and opposers (#29, #33)
```


## Figure 6
```{r}


library(cowplot)

# ---- Top row: MOA classes ----
moa_core <- ggarrange(
  mimicker_MOA_plot,
  opposer_MOA_plot,
  ncol = 2,
  align = "hv"
)

moa_plots <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(
    moa_core,
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    width = 1,
    height = 0.90
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "a",
    x = 0.00, y = 0.90,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold", size = 10
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "Recovery-mimicking MOA classes",
    x = 0.2, y = 0.90,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 7
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "b",
    x = 0.52, y = 0.90,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold", size = 10
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "Recovery-opposing MOA classes",
    x = 0.7, y = 0.90,
    hjust = 0, vjust =0, size = 7
  )


# ---- Bottom row: compounds ----
compound_core <- ggarrange(
  top_mimickers_plot,
  top_opposers_plot,
  ncol = 2,
  align = "hv"
)

compound_plots <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(
    compound_core,
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    width = 1,
    height = 0.98
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "c",
    x = 0.00, y = 0.96,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold", size = 10
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "Recovery-mimicking compounds",
    x = 0.16, y = 0.96,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0,size = 7
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "d",
    x = 0.52, y = 0.96,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold", size = 10
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "Recovery-opposing compounds",
    x = 0.66, y =0.96,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 7
  )



# ---- Final figure ----
fig6 <- ggarrange(
  moa_plots,
  compound_plots,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "hv",
  heights = c(1.45, 4)
)

ggsave(fig6, filename = "Figures/CMap (Figure 3).jpg", width = 180, height = 160, units = "mm", dpi = 600)

```
